name: geosql
description: GeoSQL plugin by Dekart: geospatial SQL and interactive maps for Claude.

plugins.name: geosql
plugins.description: Geospatial SQL and maps for BigQuery, Snowflake, DuckDB, Wherobots and Postgres: discovers Overture Maps and warehouse schemas, writes cost-safe SQL with a dry-run budget check, validates results and renders them on an interactive Dekart map through the GeoSQL MCP tools or the dekart CLI.
